week11.physical: The action is at the local foot of the ascent. Spectators stand uphill, above both principals.
week11.civic_use: The approach gives the public room to watch. The private After Dark interview uses a different setup.
week11.continuity: Week 10 damaged Jake’s home approach. Match the prior plate before placing a particular scar in this view.

set_dressing.surface: A boot-worn inside turn beneath the spectator bank.
set_dressing.local_routine: The uphill spectators make a gap for a porter. Brandon catches why the crowd moved.
set_dressing.camera_continuity: Retain the gap and direction of travel in the reverse. Any Week 10 damage visible at this foot of the ascent needs a matching view.

owner_story_detail.requested_by: Brandon Pryor requested the Wolf Brand Chili drenching. Jake Kaloper supplied the carnival dunk tank and D5 Texas quarterback heckle.
owner_story_detail.action: Jake volunteers for the dunk seat and jokes about Brandon’s D5 Texas throwing. Brandon hits the side target with one ball. Jake falls into a tank full of Wolf Brand Chili. One silent shot through the window shows his face and raised hand entirely below the surface. He comes up soaked from head to boots.
owner_story_detail.timing: The dunk works before the result. Hold the quiet playoff line for the loss branch. An official elimination caption requires an independently established standings outcome.
owner_story_detail.production_prop_choice: Red Wolf Brand Chili can with blue NO BEANS band on the booth ledge. The tank is filled with chili.

week11.archived_sporting_record: 16 regular-season meetings. In 2023 W13, the slots met as Benedict Kenobi and The Blew Waffle’s, 144.76–143.72.
week11.placed_evidence: Week 10 pp. 23–25 damaged Jake’s home approach. The Week 11 audience stands uphill of both rivals. The exact turn needs a matching earlier view before it can inherit a scorch mark.
week11.inklings_application: A porter clears the public path before Brandon’s Wolf Brand Chili scene. Jake’s head-to-boot drenching is a Week 11 request. The old score belongs in the shack clipping.
week11.historical_method: A box score establishes a game between franchise slots. Its venue, an early custom and historical owner identity need separate sources.

week11.physical: Midspan of the narrow bridge, with the lake visible on both sides.
week11.civic_use: This is a shared crossing. Wilson and Austin meet between the two approaches.
week11.continuity: Week 10 physical page 33 establishes the intact deck and opposite piers.

set_dressing.surface: Wheel-polished intact center stones with a slightly rougher reset stone beside a working lantern.
set_dressing.local_routine: A carter waits at the approach, watches the fall and waits for the loser to surface.
set_dressing.camera_continuity: Keep the lamp and reset stone together in the reverse. Both lake edges must clear the figures in the midspan master.

owner_victory_coda.trigger: Confirmed ESPN Week 11 win over D0nkey K0ng
owner_victory_coda.sequence: Austin’s nearly fatal final strike sends Wilson off the bridge into the lake. Once Wilson surfaces, Austin drops him the cap and names him jester from the parapet. Wilson takes it and makes for shore as Austin walks away.
owner_victory_coda.on_other_result: Keep the cap packed. Use the Wilson-win or unresolved bridge ending.

duel_finish.verified_winner: A violent, nearly fatal final strike drives the loser off the intact bridge and into the lake. The winner stays on deck as the loser surfaces alive and makes for shore. Their separation closes the storyline.
duel_finish.if_wilson_wins: Wilson sends Austin into the lake and waits until he hears him cough. Austin keeps his belt.
duel_finish.if_austin_wins: Austin sends Wilson into the lake. Apply the jester appointment across the distance.
duel_finish.pending_or_tied: Hold at midspan with both on the bridge.

week11.archived_sporting_record: 11 regular-season meetings. In 2025 W9, slot 5 beat slot 8, 179.68–111.42.
week11.placed_evidence: Released Week 3 pp. 3–4 put ObiWan and Three Dreaded Snake at the bridge and lake. World Memory records the decision landmark. Week 10 physical p. 33 returns to the intact deck with Wilson and Austin at opposite ends.
week11.inklings_application: Open on the two approaches. Let a returning reader recognize the drop before the carter reacts. The stone bridge, jump point and lake are distinct features.
week11.historical_method: A box score establishes a game between franchise slots. Its venue, an early custom and historical owner identity need separate sources.
